title: Pan-Seared Ribeye with Red Wine Pan Sauce
short: A steakhouse crust, butter-basted finish and a glossy two-minute pan sauce.

ings.i: ribeye steaks, about 300 g (10 oz) each and 3–4 cm (1¼–1½ in) thick
unsalted butter, divided (2 tbsp + 1 tbsp cold)
dry red wine (Cabernet Sauvignon or Merlot)

pairing.wine: Cabernet Sauvignon or Argentine Malbec: the tannin cuts through the marbling.
pairing.zero: Sparkling tart-cherry juice with a bruised rosemary sprig.

makeahead: Salt the steaks the night before and mince the shallot in the afternoon. Everything else happens in the last 20 minutes.

title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
short: Golden mushrooms, porcini stock and a loose, glossy finish that ripples on the plate.

ings.i: small onion or large shallot, finely diced
finely grated Parmigiano Reggiano or a vegetarian hard cheese

pairing.wine: Pinot Noir or a lightly oaked Chardonnay: both mirror the earthiness.
pairing.zero: Chilled Earl Grey with a strip of lemon peel.

makeahead: Soak the porcini, slice the mushrooms and dice the onion up to a day ahead. You can sear the mushrooms an hour before.

title: Seared Scallops with Lemon Brown Butter
short: Five minutes of cooking, a golden crust and a nutty, lemony butter sauce.

pairing.wine: Chablis, Champagne or another crisp, unoaked white.
pairing.zero: Sparkling water with lemon peel and a sprig of thyme.

makeahead: Prep and dry the scallops up to 4 hours ahead and keep them uncovered in the fridge on paper towels.

title: Burrata with Blistered Tomatoes & Basil Oil
short: Warm, jammy tomatoes against cold, creamy burrata. Ready in 15 minutes.

pairing.wine: Dry Provençal rosé or a light Italian red served slightly chilled.
pairing.zero: Sparkling water with a basil leaf and lemon.

makeahead: Make the basil oil up to a day ahead; it keeps its color best covered in the fridge.

title: Gambas al Ajillo (Spanish Garlic Shrimp)
short: Shrimp sizzling in garlicky olive oil with smoked paprika. Bring bread for dipping.

ings.i: red pepper flakes or 1 small dried chili
crusty bread, to serve (skip for gluten-free)

pairing.wine: Albariño or a chilled fino sherry.

makeahead: Peel the shrimp and slice the garlic in the morning; cooking takes six minutes.

title: Lemon-Herb Salmon en Papillote
short: Salmon and vegetables steamed in parchment parcels that you open at the table.

ings.i: skinless salmon fillets, 150–170 g (5–6 oz) each
lemon, thinly sliced, plus its zest
butter (or more olive oil for dairy-free)
sheets parchment paper, about 40 × 30 cm (16 × 12 in)

pairing.wine: Sauvignon Blanc, or Pinot Noir for red lovers.

makeahead: Assemble the parcels up to 4 hours ahead and refrigerate. Add 2 minutes to the baking time.

title: Chicken Piccata
short: Thin golden cutlets in a bright lemon, caper and butter sauce.

ings.i: boneless skinless chicken breasts (about 450 g / 1 lb), halved horizontally
unsalted butter, divided (1 tbsp + 2 tbsp cold)

pairing.wine: Pinot Grigio, Vermentino or another zesty Italian white.

makeahead: Pound and season the cutlets in the morning; keep them covered in the fridge.

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
short: Garlic, olive oil, chili and pasta water turned into a silky sauce. Pantry magic.

ings.i: kosher salt, for the pasta water
lemon zest, plus a squeeze of juice
grated Parmesan, to serve (optional; not vegan)

pairing.wine: Verdicchio or a young Chianti.

makeahead: Slice the garlic and chop the parsley ahead; this dish is cooked to order.

title: Handmade Tagliatelle with Brown Butter & Sage
short: Fresh egg pasta made together, in the simplest, most luxurious sauce.

ings.i: '00' flour or all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting

pairing.wine: Soave or a soft Barbera.
pairing.zero: Sparkling apple juice with a sage leaf.

makeahead: Dough keeps wrapped in the fridge for 24 hours. Cut nests can be frozen on a tray and cooked from frozen (add 1 minute).

title: Thai Green Curry with Shrimp
short: Fragrant coconut curry with snappy shrimp, Thai basil and lime.

ings.i: green curry paste (check the label for gluten if needed)
Japanese eggplant or ½ red bell pepper, bite-size

pairing.wine: Off-dry Riesling or Gewürztraminer to cool the heat.

makeahead: Cut the vegetables and peel the shrimp ahead. The curry base can be made a day ahead; reheat and add vegetables and shrimp to order.

title: French Onion Soup for Two
short: Deeply caramelized onions under a bubbling lid of Gruyère toast.

ings.i: dry white wine or dry sherry

pairing.wine: Beaujolais or a dry French cider.
pairing.zero: Sparkling apple juice with a thyme sprig.

makeahead: Make the soup up to 3 days ahead. Reheat, then toast and broil just before serving.

title: Molten Chocolate Lava Cakes for Two
short: Crisp edges, a liquid chocolate center and five ingredients.

ings.i: soft butter and 1 tsp cocoa powder, for the ramekins
berries, whipped cream or vanilla ice cream, to serve

pairing.wine: Banyuls or ruby port.
pairing.zero: A short espresso or hot chocolate with a pinch of sea salt.

makeahead: Fill the ramekins up to 24 hours ahead and keep them covered in the fridge.

title: Tiramisu Cups (No Raw Eggs)
short: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone cream, layered in glasses the night before.

pairing.wine: Vin Santo or a sweet Marsala.
pairing.zero: Cold brew over ice with an orange twist.

makeahead: Make it the night before; it improves overnight.

title: Chocolate-Dipped Strawberries
short: Glossy dark chocolate, crunchy toppings, ready in 20 minutes.

ings.i: large strawberries with green tops, washed and completely dry
toppings: crushed pistachios, flaky salt, freeze-dried raspberry

pairing.wine: Brut rosé Champagne or Moscato d'Asti.

makeahead: Best within 6 hours of dipping. Keep at cool room temperature.

title: Crème Brûlée for Two
short: Silky vanilla custard under a glassy, crackling sugar crust.

ings.i: vanilla bean, split (or 1 tsp vanilla extract)
sugar, plus 2 tbsp for the topping

pairing.wine: Sauternes or a late-harvest Riesling.

makeahead: Bake up to 2 days ahead. Torch just before serving.

title: Shakshuka for Two
short: Eggs poached in spiced tomato and pepper sauce, served from the pan.

pairing.wine: A mimosa or a dry rosé for a late brunch.
pairing.zero: Fresh orange juice topped with sparkling water.

makeahead: Make the sauce the night before. Reheat until bubbling and add the eggs.

title: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
short: Cloud-light, lemony pancakes for a slow morning.

ings.i: berries and maple syrup, to serve

pairing.wine: Prosecco for a celebration brunch.

makeahead: Mix the dry ingredients the night before.

title: Pomegranate-Rosemary Spritz
short: A jewel-red sparkling drink, zero-proof by default, with an optional bubbly upgrade.

ings.i: rosemary sprigs (2 for syrup, 1 to garnish)
chilled sparkling water (or Prosecco, if your guest drinks)

pairing.wine: Serve as the welcome drink before any menu.

makeahead: Make the syrup up to two weeks ahead.

title: Crispy Smashed Potatoes with Garlic & Herbs
short: Creamy inside, shatteringly crisp outside. The side that steals the show.

pairing.wine: Follows the main dish.

makeahead: Boil and smash them hours ahead; roast just before dinner.

title: Little Gem Salad with Lemon-Dijon Vinaigrette
short: Crisp lettuce wedges, a bright shallot dressing and toasted nuts.

ings.i: heads little gem lettuce (or 1 romaine heart)

pairing.wine: Follows the main dish.

makeahead: Make the dressing up to 3 days ahead.
